svg.title: Customer Churn MLOps — C4 Level 2, containers
svg.desc: In Docker Compose: the Churn Desk (Astro + nginx, port 4321) calls the FastAPI prediction API (port 8000), which loads classifier.joblib from the ./models volume. The worker, built from the same image, serves three Prefect deployments on cron 02:00, 04:00 and 06:00 UTC against the Prefect server (port 4200), reads Churn_Modelling.csv, writes the model to ./models and logs every run to MLflow (port 5000).
svg.text: Customer Churn MLOps — the compose stack
One image, two roles: the same backend image serves predictions and runs the scheduled flows.
Uses the desk in a browser
Serves the flows all / train / evaluat
written by the worker; the API
Retrained models land in ./models on the host; `docker compose restart backend` serves them.
A tracking outage is a warning, never a pipeline failure (src/tracking.py).
